title: Implement AgentCore run loop state machine
purpose: Implement the deterministic orchestration loop that advances a PlanRun through planning, execution, observation, verification, approval pauses, and terminal states.
scope: Create AgentCore with accept_intent, plan_run, advance_run, approve_step, deny_step, suspend_run, and recover_run operations.
Persist every state transition through RunStore before external effects are attempted.
Delegate all side-effecting work to the Security Execution Foundation.
Pause on high-risk policy decisions until exact approval is attached.
Fail closed if the planner, model broker, policy, executor, audit, or rollback layer returns inconsistent state.
Expose a compact run-state projection for TUI and CLI.
acceptance_criteria: AgentCore can accept an intent and produce a persisted Planned state.
Read-only steps can advance automatically through verification and sealing.
Execute-with-confirmation steps pause and do not prepare effects before approval.
Denied or timed-out approvals move to Denied or Suspended without execution.
Crash-safe state updates are visible through RunStore.
verification: Run CLI demo for a read-only diagnostic plan.
Run approval-required plan and confirm AwaitingApproval state.
Inspect audit timeline for valid event ordering.
risk_notes: This is the central runtime component; it must remain boring and deterministic.
implementation_steps: Implement accept_intent, plan_run, advance_run, approve_step, deny_step, suspend_run, and recover_run operations.
Persist state transitions through RunStore before invoking any external effect path.
Call SecurityExecutionEngine for every side-effecting PlanStep and reject any alternate execution path.
Pause approval-required steps before EffectPrepared and bind exact approval before retrying advancement.
Map planner, policy, executor, audit, rollback, and recovery inconsistencies to Suspended, RollbackPending, or FailedClosed.
Expose compact CLI/TUI run-state projection without raw secret values.
failure_modes: Approval timeout or denial prepares an effect.
AgentCore calls ToolRouter, executor, or shell directly instead of SecurityExecutionEngine.
Crash after transition cannot be recovered from RunStore.
Policy, audit, or EffectEnvelope mismatch is ignored.
TUI or CLI projection leaks secret-like data.

verification_matrix.expected: read-only, approval pause, denial, timeout, and failed-closed transitions pass
projection reflects current run state without secret leakage
all existing safety and recovery tests pass

blocked_until: Read-only steps can seal through SEF.
Denied or timed-out approval never executes.
